catalogue.name: ES - Church of Sunna
catalogue.readme:
In the impoverished and forgotten corners of Sonnstahl, where life is grim and uncertain, the grip of the Empire is tenuous at best. In these lands, steel is a luxury and gunpowder is unheard of. Yet, amid the gloom and despair, there burns a faith in Sunna that shines with an unrelenting brightness, serving as an indomitable bulwark for its people against the many perils that lurk in the shadows.

There the Empire maintains at best a few units: usually local hirees, given decomissioned armours and weapons, based in sparse garrisons and patrolling the roads to ensure a semblance of protection. It is in the face of true danger that the strength of these backwater areas is revealed, when its people heeds to call of the only authority they respect: the Church of Sunna. In those occasions, nothing and no one can stand in the way of these mobs... nor of their shepherds.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: This spell targets the caster and any unit it has joined. Enemy units in base contact with at least one target suffer D6 hits, Str 4, AP 0.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: This spell targets the caster and any unit it has joined. The target gains Aegis (5+) against Melee attacks until your next magic phase.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: This spell targets the caster and any unit it has joined. The target rerolls failed to Wound rolls until your next magic phase.

sharedRules.name: Blessed Steel
sharedRules.description: The model gains +2 Agi, +1 Str and +1 AP.

sharedRules.name: Fanatical
sharedRules.description: The unit cannot declare a Flee reaction, and automatically passes all Panic and Break test.

sharedRules.name: Insignificant
sharedRules.description: The unit only causes Panic Tests on friendly units with Insignificant. A unit joined by a Character is no longer Insignificant.

sharedRules.name: Prayers
sharedRules.description: The model can cast the army-specific spells Sunna's Blessing, Ullor's Blessing and Vollund's Blessing.

sharedRules.name: War Altar
sharedRules.description: The model is mounted (see Special Mounts). Prayers used by the model now target the caster and all friendly units within 8”.

sharedRules.name: Bow
sharedRules.description: Shots 1, Range 24″, Str 3, AP 0. First 3 ranks shoot.
